correction: A guard that reads workflow events from a parsed YAML node must resolve aliases (*name) and merge keys (<<) at every level: the on key, its value, sequence items and mapping keys. AliasNode.Value is the anchor name, not the value, so an alias could hide pull_request_target from the guard (cross-review finding).
evidence: frostyard/updex#530 cross-review: on: [*event] with name: &event pull_request_target passed the first version of the guard
